articles.summary: Today we announced that preclinical data on ZW1953, a novel multispecific T cell engager (TCE) with integrated CD28 co-stimulation for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia (AML), will be presented at the 68th American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting and Exposition taking place on December 12-15, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. articles.title: Zymeworks to Present Preclinical Data on ZW1953, a Multispecific T Cell Engager with Integrated CD28 Co-stimulation for Acute Myeloid Leukemia, at ASH 2026
